quoting.heading: How quotes work
quoting.note: Fees are quoted per enquiry rather than listed, because the final figure depends on the factors below.

process.title: Send your enquiry
process.detail: Tell us the event, date, location and the format you have in mind.

process.title: We review availability
process.detail: We check the date against existing commitments and confirm whether it can proceed.

process.title: You receive a quote
process.detail: A written quote covering fee, travel, and any content or exclusivity terms.

process.title: Contract and invoice
process.detail: Terms are agreed in writing and invoiced. Nothing is payable through this site.

faq.a: Appearance fees move with event type, location, travel, timing and exclusivity, so a listed number would be wrong more often than right. Send an enquiry and you will get a written quote covering the whole engagement.

faq.q: How far ahead should I enquire?
faq.a: As early as you can. Dates are held against existing commitments, and international travel or exclusivity checks take longer to confirm.

faq.q: Is anything payable through this site?
faq.a: No. This site only collects enquiries. Any fee is agreed in a written contract and invoiced separately — treat a request to transfer money through a booking page as a warning sign.

faq.q: Can we film or photograph the appearance?
faq.a: Usually, with the usage agreed in advance. Tell us what you intend to capture and where it will run, and it will be covered in the quote.
